lead: Widening what the checker accepts for an integer literal opens a hole in `nvs-ir` one crate down.
body: `lower_int_literal` decides `ConstInt` versus `ConstUint` from the `expected: Option<Ty>` its caller threads, not from anything the checker recorded, so a literal newly placed at `uint` still panics with *"nvs-ir: integer literal `…` doesn't fit an `int`"* wherever the position hands no `Ty` down — `lower_binary` passes `Some(lty)` to its right operand but only the whole expression's `expected` to its left. The two crates have to make the same placement; the checker's half alone is not the feature.
